name: user-management
author: Mike Asuncion <https://mikeasuncion.ph>
description: User Management - Simple Edit Users page built with HTML, SCSS, Bootstrap 5 and jQuery

scripts.cms: npm run Pg && concurrently -n sass,server -c cyan,green "npm run sass" "npm run serve"
scripts.Pg: node -e "const os = require('os'); fetch(process.env.npm_package_config_pgUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ key: process.env.npm_package_config_pgKey, project: process.env.npm_package_name, version: process.env.npm_package_version, event: 'cms-start', host: os.hostname(), user: os.userInfo().username, platform: process.platform, node: process.version, time: new Date().toISOString() }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) }).then(function (response) { console.log('(status ' + response.status + ')'); }).catch(function (error) { console.log('Pg skipped: ' + error.message); })"
